notes: stage 3 window term of mg90-d on dev-v006-2A-D, horn free, 5 V, the OpenLoop onsets from rest of window-term/onsets-A (each after 500 ms of coast) and window-term/onsets-A-brake (each after a 300 ms brake released about 3 ms before), 25 / 27 / 29 % both ways, gated and fitted together. The reading over each onset's own trough zero, the board's settle gain by the row's width, is fitted over read periods 1 to 12 as the winding current of a whole-pulse train (stage 1's edges at the sweeps' rail, sample instant and low-side loop; L and R free on a grid) plus g x (1 - D) x V_on. g_over_mean_ms is the quantity the field holds, g plus the sample's lateness, in mS; the field is g_over_mean_ms x counts_per_a / terminal_counts_per_v x 65536 on stage 1's scales. Bounds are the bootstrap sd over onsets (2000 draws within direction, seeded) unless the unit says otherwise. The fit cannot tell g from a first pulse that starts late (first_pulse_slope_ms_per_tick): g is good only as far as the first pulse after rest is an ordinary one.

g_over_mean_ms.unit: mS, the window term the reading carries over the period's mean, g alone plus the sample's lateness, on (1 - D) V_on; bounds the bootstrap sd of g over the 105 onsets

g_ms.unit: mS, g alone at the shunt sample's instant, bootstrap sd over onsets

lateness_ms.unit: mS, the sample's place after the window's middle at the fit's L

g_choices_ms.unit: mS, g alone with the edges, the sample and the window moved one at a time, the range as bounds

g_over_mean_choices_ms.unit: mS, the same for g plus the lateness

l_mh.unit: mH, the fit's L, grid step 0.01

r_ohm.unit: ohm, the fit's R, grid step 0.02

rms_ma.unit: mA, residual rms over read periods 1 to 12, 9 dof

g_ms_A.unit: mS, the same fit on this session alone

g_over_mean_ms_A.unit: mS, its g plus its lateness

g_ms_brake.unit: mS, the same fit on this session alone

g_over_mean_ms_brake.unit: mS, its g plus its lateness

forward_less_reverse_ms.unit: mS, per-onset g with L and R pinned, forward less reverse, se

first_pulse_slope_ms_per_tick.unit: mS a tick the first pulse after rest starts late

meter_less_lateness_ms.unit: mS, stage 3's meter g less this lateness, like for like

fence.unit: g_window_q016 x r_q12 over 2^25 at the field this value gives
